Title: God Is Near
Body: The LORD is near to the brokenhearted and saves the crushed in spirit. Today, remember that God is not distant from your pain. He draws near to those who feel weak or overwhelmed.
Question: Where do you feel brokenhearted right now?
Prayer: Lord, draw near to me in my weakness.

Title: New Every Morning
Body: God’s mercies are new every morning. Your failures from yesterday do not disqualify you from walking with Him today.
Question: What 'yesterday' are you still carrying?
Prayer: Thank You for fresh mercy today. Help me start again.

Title: He Knows Your Name
Body: God calls you by name. You are not forgotten. You are seen, known, and loved personally.
Question: Where do you feel unseen or overlooked?
Prayer: Jesus, thank You that You know my name.

Title: Anxious Hearts
Body: God invites you to bring your anxieties to Him in prayer. His peace isn’t the absence of problems but His presence in them.
Question: What is making you anxious today?
Prayer: Lord, guard my heart and mind with Your peace.

Title: Strength in Weakness
Body: God’s power shines brightest in weakness. You do not need to pretend to be strong for God to work.
Question: Where do you feel weak or inadequate?
Prayer: Jesus, show Your strength in my weakness.

Title: He Cares
Body: Casting your cares on God is an ongoing practice. Keep bringing the same burden to Him.
Question: What burden do you keep picking back up?
Prayer: Lord, help me trust that You truly care.

Title: Rest for Your Soul
Body: Jesus invites you to rest—not only physically, but deeply, at the soul level.
Question: What burdens are you carrying alone?
Prayer: Jesus, teach my soul to find rest in You.
